name: Ai Tenshi Densetsu Wedding Peach Daraku no Tenshi-tachi
original_name: 愛天使伝説ウェディングピーチ堕落の天使達
source:
As a result of Rain Devilla's reformation, the demon world stops all fighting, and the human world is led to think that they will finally have peace.
However, the demons continue to prowl after the Love Angels.

A grand performance where Wedding Peach characters Daisy, Lily and Salvia are attacked and assaulted.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034284.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
由于雷恩·德维拉的改革，魔界停止了一切战斗，人类世界也被认为终于迎来了和平。
然而，恶魔们继续追捕爱天使。

婚礼桃子角色黛西、莉莉和萨尔维亚受到袭击和殴打的盛大表演。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034284.html]DLsite English[/url]]
